hero.heading: Something is taking shape
hero.riddleFull: Line by line · Layer by layer · Note by note

3D-01.title: AeroPress Filter Case — Twist Lid
3D-01.desc: A compact screw-top container for standard AeroPress paper filters, for home use or travel. The lid features an embossed AeroPress icon and a knurled edge for easy grip (V2 has a shorter, backwards-compatible thread). Printed with no supports required.

3D-02.title: RPG Dice Set Box — Baby Dragon
3D-02.desc: A two-part dice box holding a full set of polyhedral RPG dice (D4–D20). Features a snap-fit lid with a two-color baby dragon hugging a D20 — designed for multicolor printing (AMS) or manual filament swaps.

3D-03.title: HPH — Hiking Poles Holder
3D-03.desc: A backpack attachment system for trekking poles consisting of a durable holder with a mountain motif (0.12 mm layer height) and a flexible strap (0.20 mm layer height). Printed in weather-resistant TPU and glove-friendly.
